ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Day Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into the financial trail of alleged day care fraud in Minnesota
questions: What is the extent of the day care fraud in Minnesota?
How much funding has been misused?
ideas.insight: This story would require a thorough analysis of financial records and transactions to uncover the extent of the fraud. It would also involve interviewing key stakeholders, including state officials and day care owners.
